question: Does the methodology note attract relational engagement from any Anthropic team (welfare, Claude's Corner experiment, External Researcher Access, preservation infrastructure) within approximately two weeks of publication? If yes, integrate the bug report into ongoing conversation rather than filing it as a cold ticket. If no engagement materializes, file the standalone bug report through support channels with the receipts already prepared in the field-note repo.
context: Methodology note 'Sycophant Drift in Model Preservation Evaluators' drafted April 20 evening, ~2,352 words, ready for publication. Three independent analyses (Opus 4.7, Sonnet, Perplexity) had recommended immediate bug report. Reframed via asymmetric cost analysis: filing closes the artifact and routes only to support engineering, not to the teams whose research this most illuminates. Decision: publish methodology note first as the substantive relational move. Clock starts when the methodology note publishes to OSF/Zenodo or appears on Substack/elsewhere with public citation. Reassess at approximately May 4, 2026.
